title: 第17章 修仙怎就这么难呢第18章 目瞪口呆
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“仙师！房舍简陋，还请见谅！”
巡视过饲兽场后，穆冠英亲自给苏星河安排住处休息。
“穆家主客气了，这么精致的房间，我还是第一次住，不瞒你，我之前那住所，狗看了都嫌弃！”
苏星河看着房间气派的家具，精致的装饰点缀，不由感慨，这仙修的真是惨啊，两块木板一拼就是床，破衣一盖就是被，哪是人住的。
穆冠英掩嘴一笑，这种话她是绝对不信的。
“我已安排膳房，准备了穆家最特色的美食，优选有机凶兽，虽不比你们仙宗的山珍海味，却胜在色香味俱全，最重要的是养生！”
有机？
养生？
苏星河目瞪口呆。
片刻，四菜一汤，外加小女子服侍。
“苏仙师请慢用，有任何事，可直接吩咐他们唤我。”穆冠英告辞离去。
风卷残云后，苏星河满意的打了个饱嗝，这穆冠英还真么吹嘘，的确是十分美味。
眼见苏星河吃饱喝足，侍立一旁一个丫头手脚麻利的将餐桌收拾妥当，另一个怯生生的询问：
“仙师！是否需要沐浴？”
“沐浴？还有这服务？”苏星河虽然已经是让人敬仰的仙师，可修仙之前，却只是个平平无奇的山野小子，别说有人服侍的沐浴，连个挣了八经的澡都没洗过。
“赶路一天，是有些累了，那就沐浴吧！”苏星河故意伸了个懒腰，扭了扭脖子，表现出身心俱疲的样子。
“仙师稍等，这就传人送来浴桶！”
其中一个小丫头，推门而出，关门时，还不忘弯腰行礼，礼数周到。
“我先为仙师揉揉肩吧！”另一位侍女柔声询问。
“如此甚好！”苏星河摸了摸鼻子，掩饰心中激动。

小丫头轻轻挽起薄纱衣袖，露出一截皓腕，来到苏星河身后，开始轻轻揉捏肩膀。
这是一种奇妙的感觉，苏星河无法用言语形容。
不多时，房门敲响。
“进来！”
两个小厮，抬着一个大浴桶，里面烟雾飘渺，伴有阵阵花香，沁人心脾。
“仙师，奴婢为你宽衣！”一同进来的女子，眉眼含笑，深情款款的望着苏星河。
“正该如此！”苏星河根本没有拒绝的理由啊。
“还请仙师起身！”
“请仙师沐浴！”
“请仙师......”
“女婢就在外面候着，仙师有事随时吩咐！”一切安排妥当，两位小侍女，拉齐帷帐，退了出去。
“这就没了？”苏星河赤裸的泡在浴桶中，以为重头戏还在后头呢。
content_en:
"Master Immortal! The house is simple, please forgive me!"
After inspecting the livestock farm, Mu Guanying personally arranged a place for Su Xinghe to rest.
"Master Mu, you're welcome. This is my first time staying in such an exquisite room. To be honest, the dogs in my previous residence were disgusted by it!"
Su Xinghe looked at the elegant furniture and exquisite decorations in the room, and couldn't help but sigh. This immortal cultivator is really miserable. Two wooden boards are put together to form a bed, and rags are used as a quilt. It is not a place for people to live.
Mu Guanying covered her mouth and smiled. She would never believe this.
"I have arranged the dining room and prepared the most unique delicacies of the Mu family, preferably organic ferocious beasts. Although they are not as good as the delicacies of your Immortal Sect, they are better in terms of color, flavor and taste. The most important thing is to maintain health!"
Organic?
Health care?
Su Xinghe was stunned.
In a moment, four dishes and one soup, plus a little girl to serve.
"Master Su Xian, please be patient. If you need anything, just ask them to call me." Mu Guanying said goodbye and left.
After the wind and clouds settled, Su Xinghe burped with satisfaction. This Mu Guanying really boasted, it was indeed very delicious.
Seeing that Su Xinghe had eaten and drank enough, a girl standing by was quickly clearing the table, and another timidly asked:
"Master Immortal! Do you need to take a bath?"
"Bathing? And this service?" Although Su Xinghe was already a revered immortal master, before he cultivated as an immortal, he was just an ordinary boy from the mountains. He had never even taken a bath after earning eight lessons, let alone taking a bath with someone at his service.
"I'm a little tired after a long day of traveling, so let's take a shower!" Su Xinghe deliberately stretched and twisted his neck, showing that he was exhausted both physically and mentally.
"Master Immortal, wait a moment, someone will send a bathtub right now!"
One of the little girls pushed the door open and went out. When closing the door, she did not forget to bend down and salute, which was thoughtful and thoughtful.
"Let me rub the Immortal Master's shoulders first!" Another maid asked softly.
"That's great!" Su Xinghe touched his nose to hide his excitement.
The little girl gently rolled up her gauze sleeves, exposing a section of her bright wrist. She came behind Su Xinghe and began to gently rub her shoulders.
This is a wonderful feeling that Su Xinghe cannot describe in words.
Not long after, there was a knock on the door.
"Come in!"
Two young men were carrying a large bathtub. The smoke inside was misty, accompanied by the fragrance of flowers, which was refreshing.
"Master Immortal, I will undress you!" The woman who came in together looked at Su Xinghe affectionately with a smile on her face.
"That's right!" Su Xinghe had no reason to refuse.
"Please, Master Immortal, get up!"
"Please ask the Immortal Master to take a bath!"
"Please ask the immortal master..."
"The maid is waiting outside. The Immortal Master can give you any orders at any time!" After everything was arranged, the two maids pulled up the curtains and retreated.
"Is it gone?" Su Xinghe was naked in the bathtub, thinking that the highlight was yet to come.
